PLEASANTS MWL CROSSING - Situated on the Kings Lynn Branch between Downham Market and Littleport. Despite appearances, there is house just the other side of the crossing hidden behind the fence on the right. It could be on another planet! Network Rail want to replace these crossings but what with? The lane ends at the house so there is only minimal traffic down this rutted, muddy lane and, in most hours, only two trains. Surely AHB's could not be justified, although the signage alone in this picture must have cost a fortune! Seen here on 11/11/14.
